messages:
nina-cs: quick note - client reported 403s for ephemeral browser tokens when using corporate mTLS gateway. Works on mobile/home. Can we triage?

leo-eng: likely mTLS terminator mutating Authorization or replacing certs causing aud mismatch. Ask them for curl -v from inside corp and the decoded JWT claims (aud/scope).

infra-sam: also check rate-limiting - some corp gateways coalesce preflights causing burstiness; ask for timestamps to correlate with our rate windows. If they can run `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -servername api.redwood.ai -showcerts`, capture the cert chain.

onboard-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdks/browser#corporate-gateways - proxy/mTLS checklist and header-casing workarounds.

nina-cs: requested: 1) curl -v from corp and from outside, 2) decoded claims (aud/scope), 3) cert chain and any x-request-id from 403. Will update when they reply. :thumbsup:
